description: Shadowfax Technologies Limited operates as a technology-led third-party logistics company in India. The company offers express forward parcel delivery; reverse pickup logistics and hand-in-hand exchange; prime delivery; quick commerce; food and on-demand delivery, mobility, and other logistics services including critical logistics, insourcing of unbundled services, and dark store operations. It serves enterprise clients including horizontal and non-horizontal e-commerce, quick commerce, food marketplace, on-demand mobility companies, and D2C companies. Shadowfax Technologies Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.
